visualGuidance.role: Character identity and palette only, supplied.

scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one inline landscape painting for Kanji Trail Around the World in Eighty Days after paragraph 0.
Input images: Kasa Jizō is simplicity/style reference only. Fogg cover is character identity and palette only, keep detail much simpler.
Show Phileas Fogg at an 1872 railway platform preparing to depart on his journey. He calmly checks a gold pocket watch, holding a modest brown travelling case. Match cover: adult gentleman with short brown hair, curled brown moustache, black top hat, long indigo coat, charcoal waistcoat, ivory shirt and dark cravat. Natural proportions and small expressive face.
Behind him an intact steam train, simplified to broad ochre and charcoal shapes, soft ivory steam, and two broad platform columns. No intricate mechanics or crowd. Quiet purposeful departure mood.
Style: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simple background with three depth layers. Muted indigo, ivory, teal, ochre and warm brown. Full bleed 12:7 landscape, Fogg clear and large at small inline size.
Constraints: opening departure only, no later travel locations or plot revelations. No lettering, readable clock numbers, signs, captions, borders or watermarks. Avoid cover-level brush grain, busy architecture, photorealism or glossy 3D.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: inline landscape painting for Kanji Trail's graded Around the World in Eighty Days, after paragraph 2.
Input images: Image 1, the story cover, is for Phileas Fogg's character identity and muted palette only; do not copy its detailed rendering or composition. Image 2, Kasa Jizō 01.webp, is the approved inline-style reference for simplicity, broad shapes and quiet background.
Scene/backdrop: A modest late-19th-century circus stage in Yokohama, Japan, with simple timber beams and a few soft lantern shapes; no signs or legible writing.
Subject: Phileas Fogg has just hurried onto the small stage and recognizes his missing servant Passepartout, who is dressed in plain, modest 1870s European travel clothes with a simple performer jacket. Their expressions show surprised relief as they reunite. Keep the figures natural and dignified; include only a few indistinct audience silhouettes.
Style/medium: hand-painted children's-book gouache illustration with broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, and restrained facial detail. Simpler and quieter than the cover.
Composition/framing: full-bleed wide landscape, approximately 12:7 to match the existing inline reader; medium-wide view with the two men clearly readable at small size and uncluttered space around them.
Lighting/mood: warm, calm stage light; a brief moment of relief during a long journey.
Color palette: muted indigo, warm ivory, sage, ochre and restrained terracotta, guided by the cover only for Fogg's identity and palette.
Constraints: depict only the reunion described in the story. Avoid adding plot events, animals, acrobatics, exaggerated clown costumes, caricature, text, readable lettering, borders or watermarks.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: inline landscape painting for Kanji Trail's graded Around the World in Eighty Days, after paragraph 3.
Input images: Image 1, the story cover, is for the existing story's muted palette only, not its composition or detailed rendering. Image 2, Kasa Jizō 01.webp, is the approved inline-style reference for broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours and quiet backgrounds.
Scene/backdrop: Open North American plains in 1872, with a transcontinental railway track crossing broad grassland beneath a spacious sky.
Subject: A large but peaceful herd of bison crosses the tracks and has brought a period steam train to a stop. A few passengers are small silhouettes looking from the windows. Make the train and herd distinct, believable and easy to read; no named character needs to be prominent.
Style/medium: hand-painted children's-book gouache illustration with broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, and quiet simplified background. Keep detail simpler than the story cover.
Composition/framing: full-bleed wide landscape, approximately 12:7 to match the existing inline reader; low, wide horizon, bison across the foreground track, stopped train receding behind them, clear silhouettes at small display size.
Lighting/mood: clear daylight; a patient pause in a long journey.
Color palette: warm ivory sky, muted sage and ochre grassland, charcoal and indigo train, subdued natural browns for the bison.
Constraints: show the peaceful train stoppage before later danger or rescue. No attacks, weapons, capture, violence, lettering, signs, borders or watermarks.
